tools.name: search_bridges
tools.description: Search US bridges in the FHWA National Bridge Inventory. Scope with state, county (3-digit FIPS code), and/or condition (Good/Fair/Poor); optional filters: posting_status (open/posted/closed/not_yet_open), owner_code, scour_critical, year_min/year_max, min_adt, route, and q (text match on facility c

tools.name: get_bridge
tools.description: Get one bridge by its FHWA structure number (Item 8). Structure numbers are unique within a state; pass state to be exact. Returns the full decoded record.

tools.name: list_bridges_in_county
tools.description: List bridges in one county (state + 3-digit FIPS county code), paged.

tools.name: get_worst_bridges
tools.description: The worst-rated bridges in a state (condition = Poor), ordered by lowest component rating then age. State is required. Use for 'worst bridges in X' questions.

tools.name: list_posted_or_closed_bridges
tools.description: Bridges in a state that are load-posted or closed to traffic (NBI Item 41 status P/R/K), worst condition first. Relevant for routing and heavy-haul feasibility — but per FHWA, NBI data must not be used as the sole source for route clearance; inspections can be up to ~24 months old.

tools.name: find_low_clearance_bridges
tools.description: Bridges in a state whose vertical clearance is at or below max_height_m. Default clearance is over the roadway on the bridge (NBI Item 10); set under=true for the clearance under the bridge (Item 54B), which is what matters for routes passing beneath. Sentinel 'no restriction' values are excluded.

tools.name: get_state_summary
tools.description: Bridge summary for one state: total bridges, counts by condition (Good/Fair/Poor), posted and closed counts, scour-critical count, average year built, total deck area. Without a state, returns per-state totals with condition counts for all states.

tools.name: get_county_summaries
tools.description: Per-county bridge counts for a state, with Poor-condition and posted/closed counts per county.
